notes.title: One Night 2: The Beyond is now on Steam!
notes.content:
The oldest and strongest emotion of mankind is fear.

Hello survivors.

The latest horror adventure from Dark Gaia Studios is now available to purchase on Steam. One Night 2: The Beyond is a classic Lovecraftian survival horror game that served as the original inspiration for Mythos: The Beginning, and players who loved the mysterious, subtly oppressive atmosphere of Mythos will feel right at home.

The Steam version of One Night 2 is greatly enhanced over the original release, featuring engine updates, rewritten dialogue, brand new rooms and areas, overhauled gameplay mechanics and much more. Experience the nightmare today, and help support future horror projects from Dark Gaia Studios.

One Night 2: The Beyond on Steam

notes.title: New patch (25/9/2018) is now online!
notes.content:
Hello survivors.

I've just uploaded a small patch fixing a couple of minor bugs that (surprisingly) have been unreported since launch.

This update fixes the following issues:
Crates no longer block the way to the Medical Room once you obtain the Drug Locker Key.
The ending message will now correctly display whether you saved Tiffany or Alex.
